task: similar resolved case retrieval for the operator assistant

weights.reason: 465 MB, regenerated in about five minutes on CPU

training.positive_rule: same region, topic and service within 120 days
training.hard_negative_rule: same region and topic, different service

split.strategy: temporal, evaluation documents never appear in training pairs

limits: Queries are executor texts. Production queries are citizen texts.
Proxy relevance is a shared (region, topic, service) group.
No pure Kazakh documents exist, so no kk slice can be reported.
Hit rate@10 is marginally below lexical (0.6925 against 0.6937). The gain is at the top of the ranking, not in the tail.
A single epoch on 7 466 pairs. No hyperparameter search was run.
metric_semantics: hit_rate_at_k is the fraction of queries with at least one relevant result, not recall over all relevant documents
